prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—location, case complexity, budget, and how comfortable you feel with the doctor all matter. A good starting point is to compare **two or three consultations** and ask who will personally supervise your treatment, whether they recommend braces or Invisalign for your case, and what the full fee includes.

A few Phoenix practices to consider:

- **Serrano Orthodontics** — Phoenix office at 1515 E. Missouri Ave.; offers braces and Invisalign. The practice says Drs. Paul and Andrew Serrano are board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics. [Website](https://serranoorthodontics.com/)
- **Dunn Orthodontics** — Phoenix office at 1515 E. Bethany Home Rd.; offers braces and Invisalign. The practice says Drs. Matthew and Courtney Dunn are board-certified. [Website](https://dunn-orthodontics.com/)
- **Murphy Orthodontics** — Phoenix office at 5355 E. High St.; offers braces and Invisalign. The practice says Dr. Chris Murphy is board-certified. [Website](https://www.murphyorthodontics.com/)

If you share your part of Phoenix, whether this is for an adult or child, and whether you’re leaning toward braces or Invisalign, I can narrow the options.
